chart.name: Top 10 Hosts by Physical Memory Utilization
Top 10 Hosts by CPU Utilization
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.user').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.wio').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.system').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.idle').publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = (A+B+C+D).publish(label='E', enable=False)
F = (A+B+C).publish(label='F', enable=False)
G = (100*F/E).max(by=['HANA_HOST']).top(by=['HANA_HOST'], count=10).publish(label='G')

chart.name: CPU Utlization
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.user').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.wio').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.system').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.idle').publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = (A+B+C+D).publish(label='E', enable=False)
F = (A+B+C).publish(label='F', enable=False)
G = (100*F/E).max(by=['HANA_HOST']).publish(label='G')

chart.name: Service Share in Overall CPU Utilization
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.service.cpu.utilization', rollup='max').above(0, inclusive=True).sum(by=['SERVICE_NAME', 'HANA_HOST']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
C = (A).sum(by=['HANA_HOST']).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (C).count().publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = (A/C/D).sum(by=['SERVICE_NAME']).publish(label='E')

chart.name: Code Memory Usage
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.host.memory.code').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('sap.hana.host.memory.shared').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A-B).top(by=['HANA_HOST'], count=10).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Physical Memory Utilization
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.host.memory.physical.free', rollup='max').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('sap.hana.host.memory.physical.used', rollup='max').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (100*B/(A+B)).max(by=['HANA_HOST']).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Pool Limit Utilization
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.host.memory.total_allocated', rollup='max').publish(label='A', enable=False)
C = data('sap.hana.host.memory.allocation_limit', rollup='max').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (100*A/C).max(by=['HANA_HOST']).publish(label='D')

chart.name: CPU Utilization
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.user').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.wio').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.system').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = data('sap.hana.host.cpu.idle').publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = (A+B+C+D).publish(label='E', enable=False)
F = (A+B+C).publish(label='F', enable=False)
G = (100*F/E).max(by=['HANA_HOST']).publish(label='G')

chart.name: Top 20 Services by Memory Pool Utilization
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.service.memory.allocation_limit', rollup='max').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('sap.hana.service.memory.allocation_limit_effective', rollup='max').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = data('sap.hana.service.memory.total_used', rollup='max').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (100*C/B).publish(label='D')

chart.name: Top 20 Service by Physical Memory Usage
Top 20 Service by Heap Memory Utilization
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.service.memory.heap.allocated', rollup='max').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('sap.hana.service.memory.heap.used', rollup='max').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (100*B/A).top(count=20).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Top 20 Services by Shared Memory Utilization
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.service.memory.shared.allocated', rollup='max').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('sap.hana.service.memory.shared.used', rollup='max').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (100*B/A).top(count=20).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Expensive Statements
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.statement.expensive.count', rollup='latest').max(by=['STATEMENT_HASH', 'DB_USER', 'HANA_HOST']).sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
J = (A).timeshift('1d').publish(label='J', enable=False)
K = (A-J).publish(label='K')
L = data('sap.hana.statement.expensive.errors', rollup='latest').max(by=['STATEMENT_HASH', 'DB_USER', 'HANA_HOST']).sum().publish(label='L', enable=False)
M = (L).timeshift('1d').publish(label='M', enable=False)
N = (L-M).publish(label='N')

chart.name: Total Duration by Schema and User
Total Size
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.table.size', rollup='latest').sum().max(over='5m').publish(label='A', enable=False)
C = (A).timeshift('1d').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (A-C).publish(label='D')

chart.name: Total Records Count
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.table.record.count', rollup='latest').sum().max(over='5m').publish(label='A', enable=False)
C = (A).timeshift('1d').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (A-C).publish(label='D')

chart.name: Total Tables Count
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.table.record.count', rollup='latest').count().max(over='5m').publish(label='A', enable=False)
C = (A).timeshift('1d').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (A-C).publish(label='D')

chart.name: Write Count by File Type
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.io.write.count').sum(by=['TYPE']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('sap.hana.io.write.async.count').sum(by=['TYPE']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
D = data('sap.hana.io.append.count').sum(by=['TYPE']).publish(label='D', enable=False)
C = (A+B+D).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Top 20 Hosts by Write Count
chart.programText:
A = data('sap.hana.io.write.count').sum(by=['HANA_HOST']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('sap.hana.io.write.async.count').sum(by=['HANA_HOST']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
D = data('sap.hana.io.append.count').sum(by=['HANA_HOST']).publish(label='D', enable=False)
C = (A+B+D).top(count=20).publish(label='C')
